verdict.rationale: Helicone documents Alerts that monitor error rates and costs on LLM requests, and lists 'Alerts & reports' as a paid-plan feature, which covers the core of the error-rate and cost-spike parts of the story. The evidence never names any notification channel. Webhooks fire on request completion rather than on threshold breaches, so routing to Slack or PagerDuty would need extra glue. Missing for 10: alerts on eval-score drops, documented delivery to Slack, PagerDuty, or email, configuration detail (thresholds, windows), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
